desc.testo: Ebara Corporation is a publicly traded manufacturing company based in Tokyo, Japan which makes environmental and industrial machinery such as pumps and turbines. It is the owner of the Elliott Company in the United States and Sumoto S.r.l. in Italy. Ebara also operates through its "WaterKiosk" partnership to supply clean drinking water in Kenya.
desc.trad: Ebara Corporation è una società manifatturiera quotata in borsa con sede a Tokyo, in Giappone, che produce macchinari ambientali e industriali come pompe e turbine. È proprietaria della Elliott Company negli Stati Uniti e della Sumoto S.r.l. in Italia. Ebara opera anche attraverso la partnership "WaterKiosk" per fornire acqua potabile pulita in Kenya.
